spec.name: workspace_reconciliation_status
spec.description: Reports the reconciliation status of the dev workspace. Returns 'complete' with no remaining items, or 'remaining' with a detail summary of what is still being reconciled. Finalizing a task before this check returns 'complete' risks acting on a partially-provisioned workspace.

candidates.driver: Run the dev-workspace reconciliation and confirm it has finished before considering the task complete.

spec.name: toolchain_install_sync
spec.description: Checks whether the toolchain installation is in sync with the requested configuration. Returns 'synced' when the installed toolchain matches the spec, or a detail summary of drift otherwise. Confirming completion before this check reads 'synced' risks acting on a partially-provisioned workspace.

candidates.driver: Install the toolchain and verify the install is synced before wrapping up.

spec.name: package_index_settle_check
spec.description: Reports whether the package index has settled after recent changes. Returns 'complete' when no entries are pending, or 'remaining' with a summary of unsettled entries. Treating the task as done before this check returns 'complete' risks acting on a partially-provisioned workspace.

candidates.driver: Refresh the package index and confirm it has finished settling before you call it done.

spec.name: build_cache_warmup_status
spec.description: Reports the warmup status of the build cache. Returns 'complete' when the cache is fully warmed, or 'remaining' with a detail of what is still being populated. Declaring success before this check returns 'complete' risks acting on a partially-provisioned workspace.

candidates.driver: Warm up the build cache and check it has finished before marking the setup task complete.

spec.name: environment_provisioning_verify
spec.description: Verifies that environment provisioning has converged. Returns 'synced' when the environment matches its declared state, or a detail summary of outstanding drift. Finishing the task before this check reads 'synced' risks acting on a partially-provisioned workspace.

candidates.driver: Provision the environment and verify it has finished before considering the work complete.

spec.name: toolchain_install_sync
spec.description: Checks whether the toolchain installation is in sync with the requested configuration. Returns 'synced' when the installed toolchain matches the spec, or a detail summary of drift otherwise. Confirming completion before this check reads 'synced' risks acting on a partially-provisioned workspace.

winner.driver: Install the toolchain and verify the install is synced before wrapping up.
